business_problem: Rexera needed to replace slow, manual, error-prone residential real estate closing workflows with a scalable AI system that could process large legal-document sets, extract critical details, and reduce risks and human effort across transactions.
solution_summary: Rexera runs its AI-assisted closing workflows on AWS, centering the implementation on Amazon Bedrock after a two-week proof of concept and a two-week migration from OpenAI. The system ingests large sets of real estate documents, including homeowners associations' agreements and property records, and uses large language models in Amazon Bedrock to extract critical details, flag obstacles, and identify counterparties such as municipalities, lenders, utilities, and homeowners associations. Rexera applies a multiple-model strategy with Meta's Llama and Anthropic's Claude in Bedrock to reduce hallucinations and bias while keeping operations stable inside its broader AWS environment. Retrieval-augmented generation supplies document-specific context, and downstream AI agents use the extracted facts to verify customer communications, run quality control across transactions, and place calls to confirm property information and request missing documents.
